title: How to clean under the toilet rim

pieces.say: Your toilet is hiding something gross under the rim.
pieces.text: Your toilet is hiding something gross under the rim.
pieces.label: HIDDEN GRIME

pieces.say: Here's the hidden spot. Lift the seat and look up under the rim.
Put on gloves and flush once.
Squeeze toilet cleaner right up under the rim.
Leave it ten minutes, then scrub upwards with the brush.
One cleaner only. Never mix toilet cleaner with bleach.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Your toilet is hiding something gross under the rim.

[intrigued] Here's the hidden spot. Lift the seat and look up under the rim.

[friendly] Put on gloves and flush once. Squeeze toilet cleaner right up under the rim. Leave it ten minutes, then scrub upwards with the brush. Flush and rinse the brush. One cleaner only. Never mix toilet cleaner with bleach.

[delighted] No more mystery smell.

[warm] Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
